description: AGSC-05-04b with AGSC-05-04a: the tool server resolves memory://<bundle-id>/<slug> to the item when <bundle-id> equals this Bundle's bundle.id, normalised to the slug before any other rule runs, and wherever the alias is accepted the item's https:// IRI (AGSC-05-01) is accepted too as the same identifier; an alias naming another Bundle is refused with AGSC-E309, because a node has no registry of other nodes' ids. Derivation: the minimal fixture is bundle.id minimal at site.base https://minimal.example/, so memory://minimal/handoff and https://minimal.example/concepts/handoff/ both name the concept handoff and read returns exactly what read {slug: handoff} returns — compared as a value, since AGSC-09-13a pins the envelope and the two calls differ in nothing else; memory://other/handoff names a Bundle this node is not, and the envelope is the error envelope of AGSC-09-13a carrying the code AGSC-E309.
note: added 2026-09-24 at rc.6; expected values derived by hand from the rule text, not from a run of any engine
